INSERT INTO utb_file_mst ( file_seq, file_repository_seq,

mapper.update: UPDATE utb_file_mst SET del_yn = 'Y', update_user = #{userId}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_seq = #{fileSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT file_repository_seq FROM utb_file_repository WHERE repository_kind = #{repositoryKind} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY create_at DESC LIMIT 1
